newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index climbs in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index climbs in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index rose 64.3 points or 1.92 percent in the week to Friday. The All Ordinaries index rose 0.7 percent.
Jan 17 Jan 10 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorer Index rosein the week with continuing active trade in the speculative resource stocks, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
Lateritic nickel explorers took centre stage after Dragon Mining NL announced encouraging results from their Weld Range joint venture in Western Australia, up four cents to 14.5 cents.
Interst overflowed to other nickel hopefuls, with Comet Gold NL up 21 cents to 68 cents, Greenstone Resources Nl up 3.5 cents to 20 cents and Kanowna Lights NL, up 16 cents to 52 cent.
Uranium counter Noble Resources NL sprang to life after an effective change in control, subject to shareholder approval, up 10.5 cents to 24 cents.
Troy Resources NL jumped 32 cents to 99 cents after strong results at the Cornishman joint venture at Southern Cross in Western Australia.

Stocks falling included Panorama Resources NL, down six cents at 43 cents, Strike Resources NL, off two cents to 16.5 cents, Pan Pacific Petroleum 1.5 cents lower at 13 cents,and Lone Star Exploration NL, down seven cents to 72 cents.
